def: Onam, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite

occurrences.text: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
